name: flow_link_lost_leads_back
description: When the server's link goes during a party match and no server answers again, the game keeps its world and says it is reconnecting (orders wait), opens a new link every 2 s, and after 30 s gives up. The link is this game's alone: the others play on and the caretaker plays its seat, so the results plate says so in its own words (Your link was lost; the caretaker plays your seat to the end of the match; the wave it stopped in, or before the first), with no banner or raw link reason over it, neither on the plate's crest nor on the party strip. The way back is to the hub, offline, which says why the party is gone (review M4 round 2).

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and node('ResultsPanel') == null and node('ConnectionOverlay').state == 1 and node('ConnectionOverlay').visible
steps.msg: the link is gone: the world stays, and the overlay says it is reconnecting

steps.assert: not Game.accepts_commands() and Game.command_refusal() == 'Reconnecting to the server'
Session.get_node('LoopbackHub').frame - cut_at >= 1800 and Session.client.reconnect_attempts >= 14 and Session.client.resumes == 0
steps.msg: it gave up only after 30 s of new links nobody answered
the match ends on the results for this game: its link was lost

steps.assert: node('ResultsSaid').text == 'The caretaker plays your seat to the end of the match.' and (node('ResultsDetail').text.contains(' · stopped in wave ') or node('ResultsDetail').text.contains(' · stopped before the first wave · '))
steps.msg: one plain line says what happens to the seat, and the match line says where it stopped
no banner or notice over the plate
the party strip leaves it to the plate: no raw 'Link lost' reason
back in the hub, offline, a party of one

steps.assert: (node('Place').text == 'Offline') and (Session.last_notice == 'Your link was lost, and the party with it. The caretaker plays your seat to the end.')
steps.msg: and the hub says why the party is gone

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == Session.last_notice and Session.hub_notice == ''
